single_story.note: All sources cover the same Oct 6, 2026 Anthropic launch of Claude for Google Workspace (public beta) plus new Docs/Sheets/Slides connectors.

the_news.text: On October 6, 2026, Anthropic put Claude for Google Workspace, a sidebar add-on for Google Docs, Sheets and Slides, into public beta on all paid Claude plans, and released new beta connectors for creating and editing Google files from Claude chat.

why_it_matters.text: Claude users can now work with it inside Google's own office apps, where Google's Gemini is already built in, so Anthropic is competing with Google on Google's home turf.

The assistant can edit files directly, so Anthropic limits it: it asks before edits by default, always pauses for some actions, and is beta-limited. Anthropic itself says users should review proposed actions, especially in files from outside their organization.

facts.text: [CLAIM: Anthropic says] Claude for Google Workspace is in public beta on all paid Claude plans and adds Claude to Google Docs, Sheets and Slides so users can work with it directly in open files.
notes: Independently reported as a launch by 9to5Google, Indian Express and XDA Developers, but the reports rely on Anthropic's announcement; no independent hands-on testing was found in the sources opened.

facts.text: [CLAIM: Anthropic says] Anthropic is also releasing new Google Docs, Sheets and Slides connectors (beta) that Claude uses to create and edit Google files from the Claude chat.
The add-on installs from the Google Workspace Marketplace; users open a file and go to Extensions > Claude > Open Claude, and one install covers all three apps.
[CLAIM: Anthropic says] Claude opens in a sidebar beside the file and can read the open doc, sheet or deck, see which text, cells or slides are selected, and edit the file directly.
[CLAIM: Anthropic says] In the default 'Ask before edits' mode each change appears as an approval card and Claude waits for approval; in 'Accept all edits' mode it applies changes without stopping.

[CLAIM: Anthropic says] Regardless of mode, Claude stops and asks before inserting an image from a web address, adding a link or removing anyone's access, shown with a 'Security review' label and no 'always allow' option; it cannot share the file, give anyone access, change ownership, create menus or scheduled automations, or load arbitrary web pages into the file.
notes: Stated in Anthropic's Help Center guide.

facts.text: [CLAIM: Anthropic says] In Docs Claude can fix a sentence or restyle a heading in place and propose larger rewrites as suggestion cards; in Sheets it can write formulas, build pivot tables and native charts, add tabs and use Python for joins or data cleaning; in Slides it can build slides from the deck's layouts and themes and flag overlapping, off-slide or hard-to-read elements.

[CLAIM: Anthropic says] The add-on requires a paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise) and a Google account permitted to install Marketplace apps; Workspace super administrators can install it for everyone or for selected groups from the Google Admin console.
notes: The plan list (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise) is from Unite.AI's reading of the Help Center guide; the Help Center page as fetched did not show the full list.

facts.text: [CLAIM: Anthropic says] Beta limits include: Claude cannot read, reply to or resolve comments in Docs, and edits land as direct edits rather than suggestions; Connected Sheets backed by BigQuery cannot be read; Slides charts are inserted as images that don't update; Firefox is not supported; Google stops any single operation after six minutes; chat history is stored per file in the browser.
notes: The Help Center page confirms the six-minute limit, Firefox problems, BigQuery limitation and per-browser chat history; the Docs comments and Slides charts limits are reported by Unite.AI citing the guide.

facts.text: [CLAIM: Anthropic says] The add-on requests two Google permissions and not access to Drive, Gmail, Calendar or contacts; Claude sees only the open file plus any connectors the user turns on; edits appear in version history under the user's name; content is not used for training.
notes: Unite.AI adds that the Marketplace permissions screen also shows access to the user's primary Google Account email address and personal info, and that inputs/outputs are deleted within 30 days (attributed to Anthropic). The Help Center page as fetched did not include the 30-day detail.

facts.text: 9to5Google notes that Gemini can already be used natively in Google Workspace apps, and frames the Claude add-on as useful for those already invested in Claude.

[CLAIM: Anthropic says] The new Docs, Sheets and Slides connectors are separate from the existing Gmail, Calendar and Drive connectors; on Team and Enterprise plans an owner or primary owner must enable them first, and Claude's access matches the user's existing Google sharing permissions.
notes: The 'separate from existing connectors' point is from Unite.AI, citing Anthropic's connector documentation, which I did not open.

facts.text: [CLAIM: Anthropic says] On Enterprise plans, the Compliance API, customer-managed encryption keys and OpenTelemetry audit export apply to the add-on.
notes: Unite.AI adds that Zero Data Retention, Bedrock/Vertex/Azure inference and HIPAA-ready organizations are not supported in the beta (attributed to the guide).

background.text: Google's own Gemini AI is already available natively inside Google Workspace apps.

terms.name: Public beta
terms.definition: A pre-final release open to all eligible users (here, all paid Claude plans) that Anthropic says still has known limits.

terms.name: Connector
terms.definition: A link that lets Claude work with another service. The new Docs, Sheets and Slides connectors let Claude create and edit Google files from the Claude chat, starting in Claude rather than in the file.

terms.name: Skill
terms.definition: A saved format or set of steps (such as a quarterly business review deck layout) that a team can reuse so the next deck follows the same format.

terms.name: Prompt injection
terms.definition: Instructions hidden in a file (for example white text or tiny fonts) written by someone else that try to make an AI act on them.

terms.name: Google Workspace Marketplace
terms.definition: Google's app store from which the Claude add-on is installed.
